basic_info.description: 871 San Jose Avenue is an investment opportunity with lots of upside.    The well-maintained building consisting of four spacious and light filled two-bedroom units all with parking and storage rooms.     2 rear facing apartments to be delivered vacant.    Located in Bernal Heights next to the Mission and Noe Valley. The 280 freeway is just a few seconds away making commuting to the South Bay a breeze.
